descriptions.animated-items: All items can now be toggled on/off individually in mod config menu and curse of the blind bug is fixed too! KingBobson is the reason this got made. He is also really good at making isaac mods. Beezy64 made the toggle system! KingBobson does it again. He fixed pretty much every bug and jankyness with the mod. No more stuttering over your head on pickup. No more disapearing item when picking up an animated active. more more jittering in shops/deals and other things! Check the discussion thread for everyone that helped make sprites! More animations added! The items in isaac but they are animated (while on the ground/on a pedestal) 90+ items are animated now and there is even mod support. Big thank you to KingBobson for doing basically all of the code. I was trying to do it myself and couldnt figure it out and he ended up doing it from sratch in like 20 min. Also another thank you to ValentinL for making it easy to add your own animations for other mod items (Instructions below and in the main.lua near the bottom) Also thank you to EID fo a way to detect ?s on the alt floors (very dumb) and Kingbobson again for helping me fix that too. I will add more overtime but wanted to get it out there. To add an animation for your own item add this to your main.lua if AnimatedItemsAPI then AnimatedItemsAPI:SetAnimationForCollectibe(YourItem, "YourItemAnimated.anm2") end Dancing Isaac is from here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2575911103&searchtext= Make sure you have Isaac.GetItemIdByName setup above it and you should be good to go. Just make an animation for your item (example animation file in the root of this mod) and place the anm2 in your gfx folder and it should work. Have fun! If any problems arise (many such cases) let me know
descriptions.better-explosions: Repentance updated many graphics, sprites and animations, but they didn't do it for the explosions, and since they could be improved in my opinion, I did this. This mod changes the explosion graphics and animation, it also adds an explosion radius to see its hitbox, and it changes the impact of the explosion on the floor too, this mod affects all kinds of explosions. P.S: This mod also affects one of The Duke of Flies/The Husk attacks, since it uses part of the explosion animation as well, however this is only graphical.
descriptions.classic-music: *** REPENTANCE UPDATE *** Fixed for Repentance. Repentance created a dilemna, which I am solving with multiple mods. Based on the option with the most user demand, this version keeps the classic DannyB music of the original, but leaves the Ridiculon Repetance tracks in place. I'm building alternate versions now that I will link right here soo that will provide the following options: (1) recycle flash isaac dannyb tracks (2) find dannyb tracks from other games that seem thematically appropriate (3) use the original antibirth tracks ************************************* Restores classic music from the original flash Binding of Isaac by [url=https://dbsoundworks.bandcamp.com/album/the-binding-of-isaac-2] DannyB[/url]. Sorry Ridiculon and Edmund, DannyB's soundtrack is part of Isaac's DNA. I'm super bummed about the apparent [url=http://edmundm.com/post/88615744465/will-you-be-working-with-danny-b-again-in-the] falling[/url] [url=https://dannybstyle.blogspot.com/2015/10/regarding-my-super-meat-boy-soundtrack.html] out[/url] between DannyB and Team Meat / Edmund. Part of my "Classic" mod series, restoring the parts of the original/older Binding of Isaac experience(s) that I feel were better: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=842545730]Classic Music[/url] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=842542183]Classic Sound Effects[/url] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=842458348]Classic SpiderMod[/url] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=842540059]Classic Found Hud[/url]
descriptions.enhanced-boss-bars: A mod that reimagines boss health bars to be more unique, customizeable and responsive. [h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*] Unique icons for every boss [*] Over 45 special bar designs [*] One bar for each individual boss and boss segement [*] Fully customizable [*] Full modding support [/list] [h2]Known Issues[/h2] [b]Double bars / vanilla and modded bars visible[/b] Double bars can be caused by changing the games language, the very first installation of this mod or a conflicting mod. This mod currently is incompatible with any other mod that alters the boss bar design in any way. This issue manifests itself that the vanilla boss hp bar is visible alongside the bars added by this mod. To fix this issue, if you have, deactivate all other mods that alter the boss bar design, and restart the game. [b]Incompatible mods[/b] [list] [*] Any mod that alters the boss bars [/list] [h2]Configuration[/h2] You can use '[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681875787]Mod config Menu[/url]' to customize this mod! Alternatively you can edit the config.lua file found in the mod files. [h2]Special Thanks[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Ferry[/b] for some awesome icons [*] [b]Sillst[/b] for the awesome mod thumbnail [*] [b]minichibis[/b] for letting us use their "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1674940041]Agnry Faic Boss Bar[/url]" icons [*] [b]Spyro[/b] for letting us use their "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=839983526]Better Boss Bar[/url]" design [*] [b]Hatterene[/b] for letting us use their "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=834198360]Better boss Bar[/url]" design [*] [b]serious max[/b] for letting us use their "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1431781210]Boss Health bar background[/url]" design [*] [b]TheSavageHybrid[/b] for letting us use their "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2515917831]Paper Healthbars[/url]" design [*] [b]hippocrunchy[/b] for letting us use their "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2530772508]Alt Horsemen (+War)[/url]" mod as an example [/list] [img]https://i.imgur.com/P6a8043.png[/img] [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/Enhanced-Boss-Bars]Any Problems or want to help? Visit this project on GitHub[/url]
descriptions.external-item-descriptions: [img]https://i.imgur.com/l9nbaxP.png[/img] This mod displays detailed information about all items, trinkets, cards, runes and pills DIRECTLY onto your screen. Say goodbye to your browser tab with platinumgod or the wiki open ;) The Steam-Workshop version of this mod is compatible with Afterbirth+, Repentance, Repentogon and Repentance+. There are also versions for [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions#versions]Rebirth or Afterbirth[/url], as well as [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions/wiki/How-to-install-the-mod]Epic Games, GoG and other sources[/url]. [img]https://i.imgur.com/bRGqujD.png[/img] [url=https://discord.gg/HhD4vMM4bZ]Need help or want to chat? Join our Discord server![/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/P6a8043.png[/img] [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions]Check this project out on GitHub![/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/QmqdAmr.png[/img] [list] [*] [b]Compatible with Afterbirth+, Repentance and Repentogon[/b] [*] Displays information for all collectibles, trinkets, cards, runes, pills, horsepills and some rooms [*] Displays [b]additional information[/b] like item type, charges, transformations, Spindown Dice results, Bag of Crafting recipes, TMTRAINER item effects (Detailed informations require REPENTOGON installed!), and much much more! [*] Mod support for nearly all mods! [*] Extended features available with [url=https://repentogon.com/]Repentogon[/url] [*] Easy to use API ([url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions/wiki]Documentation here[/url]) [*] A huge amount of custom options like: [list] [*] Indicators [*] Font styles [*] 17+ Languages [*] And a lot of visual options! [/list] [/list] [b]Press F2 to hide/show the descriptions![/b] [img]https://i.imgur.com/NqSBJqj.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/nl8lCfN.png[/img] Supported Languages: Chinese, Czech, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Brazilian-Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese To change the language, just edit the "Language" setting in the configuration. We recommend to install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]'Mod Config Menu Impure'[/url] to easily change the configuration ingame. [img]https://i.imgur.com/RVtZEqp.png[/img] For [b]Steam users[/b], simply press the "Subscribe" button on the mod's Steam Workshop page. This will automatically install the mod for you. For [b]manual mod installation[/b], read this tutorial "[url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions/wiki/How-to-install-the-mod]How to install the mod[/url]" If you have problems installing use the [url=https://wofsauge.github.io/IsaacDocs/rep/faq/interactive_FAQ.html]Interactive FAQ[/url]. [img]https://i.imgur.com/PFTZnfC.png[/img] Simply install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]'Mod Config Menu Impure'[/url]. You can use it to configure the mod while playing. Alternatively, edit the `eid_config.lua` file like described [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions/wiki/Edit-the-configuration-manually]here[/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/vUP4whT.png[/img] There are multiple Versions of the mod, depending on which DLCs you have installed. [b]You are currently looking at the version for Afterbirth+ and Repentance.[/b] [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions#versions]Click here for the Rebirth or Afterbirth Versions[/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/jrdGbna.png[/img] [url=https://github.com/wofsauge/External-Item-Descriptions/blob/master/CREDITS.md]Check out the credits here[/url]

Due to bugs and errors with other mods, it was changed to a general death animation for all PJs. Thanks to Not Your Sagittarius for the great animation she made and based this mod (https://twitter.com/NY_Sagittarius) IMPORTANT: Not compatible with mods that replace death animations and their sounds (isaac dies new.wav). Any bugs or errors you find, write me in the comments. Thanks :3
descriptions.hanging-dream-catcher: [h2]"Sweet Dreams, Isaac"[/h2] This non-intrusive addition to the Dream Catcher will spawn as a hanging dream catcher when the boss room is completed, to serve as a reminder to NOT SKIP THE TRANSITION! Using the Ehwaz Rune or We Need To Go Deeper! will also create a hanging dream catcher. NOTE: The hanging dream catcher will spawn on all boss room wins, including labyrinth floors on the first boss.

descriptions.live_planetarium_chance: [h1]You do [b]NOT[/b] get planetarium chance by "skipping treasure rooms" AND I'M TIRED OF PRETENDING OTHERWISE![/h1] ... [i]*ahem*[/i] This mod is a blatant copy paste of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2489006943]Planetarium Chance [REP+][/url] but instead of showing the current floor's chance, it instead shows the [b]next floor's planetarium chance[/b]! After all, what use is there in knowing the chances of something that's already happened? At that point it either happened or it didn't! No, the planetarium chance stat should work like the devli deal chance, that being a number that goes down by playing the game normally! You SHOULD feel bad for entering treasure rooms! You SHOULD be depressed when you get a bad planetarium item because all that planetarium chance is now gone forever! this mod also makes sausage 6.9% more satisfying because now you can actually see it increasing all of your stats [h3]yeah ok but how does it work[/h3] This mod does not show the actual planetarium chance in the game's code, rather an estimation by checking everything that affects planetarium chance. It's just as thorough as [url=https://bindingofisaacrebirth.wiki.gg/wiki/Planetarium]the wiki page[/url], so hopefully that's good enough! [h3]Compatibility[/h3] Does [b]NOT[/b] work with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2489006943]Planetarium Chance [REP+][/url], since this is a blatant copy of that mod! Works with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=330314079]Planetarium Chance Expanded[/url] in case you need more chances to lose planetarium chance! Works with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2748584047]Planetariums in Greed Mode[/url]. Considering I copied like half of that mod's functions, I might as well make it compatible. Might not work with mods that change the structure of greed mode. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3503885496]Heaven's Call[/url] adds a bunch of stuff but all I care about is the pill that gives you planetarium chance. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3305869734]Passive Skill Trees[/url] grants a lot of increases to your base planetarium chance, as well as a specific thing that does a specific thing that I don't fully understand? but it works well enough [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3778123093]Fiend Folio: RELOADED[/url] added REPENTOGON as a dependency just so they could add a few items that adds planetarium chance no other reason Any mod not listed here that adds a way to gain planetarium chance or changes how planetariums spawn will not be compatible with this mod. [h3]Recommendations[/h3] ... aside from the mods I made to be compatible with this one, also consider checking out: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3297124416]The Stars Align - Planetarium Notification[/url], since you no longer have the means to know your current floor's planetarium chance. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2722017893]Andromeda[/url], a character designed around Planetariums.
descriptions.mantle-rework: This mod touches up a number of features related to the various sources of Holy Mantle-like effects in the base game. The exact changes this mod makes are:[list][*]Different sources of Mantle effects now have unique sprites on the health bar. [*]Wooden Cross and Holy Card no longer interfere with each other -- if you have the trinket and use a card, they will now stack to two shields. This is also true of Holy Mantle and Dogma. [*]The order in which Mantle effects break has been changed to be more useful and intuitive, where the more renewable effects break before the one-use effects. Specifically, this new order is Holy Mantle, then Blanket, then Dogma, then Wooden Cross, then Holy Card. [*]Wooden Cross now works with trinket multipliers. This means that a golden cross, or a cross while holding Mom's Box, will provide two shields per floor instead of one.[/list] All points but the first can be disabled using Mod Config Menu. This makes the mod entirely hands-off with the gameplay, making it certified Purist Friendly™. This mod will work in two-player multiplayer, but won't in games with three or more players because I wasn't able to test that myself.
descriptions.minecraft_itemdrop: [b]This mod adds an animation when the player dies, dropping their items on the ground.[/b] It is only [u]visual[/u] and no pickups actually drop! It also doesn't change or add any sound effects, and does not modify the actual player animation. It simply adds the item drop animation on top of player death animation and works with custom death animations. When reviving or when another player is still alive, the animation will quickly fade away. [u]Resprites of items/pickups and other death animations mods will work with this mod![/u]
descriptions.neko-hush: Is Hush too scary? Then make him cute! (sort of) This mod edits all of hush's sprites and animations and adds cute cat-ears, whiskers, and mouth! It works with both AFTERBIRTH & REPENTANCE Files edited are the following: \resources\gfx\bosses\afterbirth\boss_078_bluebaby_hush.png \resources\gfx\bosses\afterbirth\boss_hush.png \resources\gfx\ui\boss\bossname_407.0_hush.png \resources\gfx\ui\boss\portrait_407.0_hush.png
descriptions.pogforgooditems: [h1] Requires Repentance [/h1] This mod does the following: [list] [*]You'll pog if you see an item that has quality 3 or higher. [/list] [i] Works for every character. [/i] This mod does not disable achievements. (as long as you've beaten Mom once) ----------------------------------------------------- This mod also works with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2487535818]Mod Config Menu[/url] now! If you like options, you can... [list] [*]Choose to bypass curse of the blind. [*]Change the minimum item quality requirement. [*]Customize pogs for any item individually. Pick your favorites. [/list] ----------------------------------------------------- The original mod, with more excessive pog: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2490418764] The POGGING of Isaac [/url] More mods, similar to this one: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2493551842] Ugh for Bad Items[/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2527902558] jerma smile for good items[/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2575911103] The Specialist for Good Items[/url]
descriptions.specialistforgooditems: [h1] DANCE! [/h1] With this mod on, Isaac will do the Specialist dance when encountering quality 4 items. Works with the entire Untainted cast, Tainted characters will use their respective untainted skin. That being said, Tainteds will eventually be added! Using Mod Config Menu you can tweak: [list] [*]The minimum item Quality Isaac will dance to. [*]Whether Isaac'll dance with Curse of the Blind or not. [*]Customize what items are dance-worthy. [*]Disable the music if you prefer to do so. [/list] It is also possible to tweak these settings manually, simply tweak the variables within 'EpicSettings' located at the top of main.lua This mod [b]is[/b] compatible with POG for Good Items, but also takes priority! Make sure they have different quality requirements so they can both be seen (since pog is for quality 3 and dance is for quality 4 by default, this is the case with no modifications). [b] Credits: [/b] Jiftoo - Programmer Devector - Graphics/Trailer Original Pog Mod (used as a base for the mod): https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2490515687 Animated Items Mod used for gif preview can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2570913695
descriptions.timemachine: ---------------------- --TimeMachine 1.7-- ---------------------- [Repentance] Let some machines work in the mode similar to Donation Machine. - Slot Machine - Fortune Telling Machine - Crane Game - Blood Donation Machine - Confessional Also some beggars.(1.4 new) - Beggar - Devil Beggar - Key Master - Bomb Bum - Battery Bum - Rotten Beggar - (1.5:now its configurable in tmmc_config.lua) (Beggars are too small, you need to align yourself to the center of their top or bottom) They will run faster and faster(with a limit) to save your (real)time!! - You can set the speed and enable/disable machines you like in "..\Steam\steamapps\common\The Binding of Isaac Rebirth\mods\timemachine_2617557401\tmmc_config.lua" ------------- -Changelog- ------------- -Oct.3, 2021 1.Added support for multiplayer games. 2.Mod now lets players get the same speed as the machine running, so as not to be used for unexpected gains. 3.When you are interacting with the machine, the timer also becomes faster. (This will not actually affect the timing of BR or hush for the time being(until 1.7)) -Oct.4, 2021 1.Added support for beggars. 2.Now it’s easier for players to align the center of machines to interact with them. -Oct.5, 2021 1.Added configuration list. Now you can customize the machine you want to take effect. 2.Fixed an issue that caused the player to pass through the beggar or get an abnormal distance from the beggar due to the speed being too fast. -Nov.18, 2021 1.fixbug for bluewomb timer. -Jan.17, 2022 ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │★Check out my other mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1630477831] GoodTrip[Repentance/AB+] [/url] ← 向你推荐★│ └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘ 【使用说明】 功能：现在你可以像玩捐款机一样越来越快地玩别的机器了！ ·小孩不是机器，救救孩子，谢谢。 (1.4：小孩现在也是机器，如果你想快速和小孩玩，你得注意对准他的正下方或者正上方。) ·速度一开始没那么快，不用担心蹭一下就被献血机抽成干，谢谢！ ·原型是去年1969定制的十连抽功能mod，几经修改后大家都很想要就努力做完了正式版( ·你可以在"Steam\steamapps\common\The Binding of Isaac Rebirth\mods\timemachine_2617557401\tmmc_config.lua"文件里设置你喜欢的速率(包括初始速率，递增的速率和到达最大值后的速率) 管他那么多！订阅就完事了！ 【更新记录】 1.2：现在不止机器会被加速，以撒也会被加速，以免利用无敌献血获取更多回报 1.3：增加了对非p1玩家的支持； 现在计时器也会加速流动避免影响平衡。 1.4：增加了对乞丐的支持，增加了微弱的辅助吸附帮助玩家对齐机器的中央。 1.5：现在可以在配置文件里自定义想要生效的机器了。解决了速度过快时穿过机器或者与机器距离不正常的问题。 1.6：修复了一个高速度时撞向乞丐会瞬移的bug。 1.7：修复了显示30分钟后凹凸门依然开启的bug。
